business.name: Maddy's Unisex Salon & Academy
business.tagline: Your Style, Your Way — Premium Hair, Beauty & Academy in Wagholi, Pune
business.address: Shop No. 18, Rainbow Crossroads, McDonald's Building, BJS College Chowk, Bakori Phata, Pune–Nagar Road, Wagholi, Pune, Maharashtra 412207, India

services.name: Signature Precision Haircut & Styling
services.description: Customized styling tailored to your face structure, hair texture and lifestyle. Includes scalp consultation, wash and blow-dry styling.

services.name: Keratin Silk Smooth Therapy
services.description: Deep protein infusion to eliminate frizz, restore shine and deliver mirror-glass smoothness for 3-5 months with L’Oréal Professionnel products.

services.name: Cysteine Hair Protein Infusion
services.description: 100% formaldehyde-free smoothing treatment ideal for damaged or chemically treated locks. Restores natural curl softness and elasticity.

services.name: Balayage / Global Color & Highlights
services.description: Master colorists using premium ammonia-free colors. Custom multi-dimensional shades designed for Indian skin undertones.

services.name: Royal Beard Sculpt & Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Precision razor shaping, essential oil softening, dual hot-towel steam press and cold aloe soothing balm.

services.name: Men's Charcoal Detox & De-Tan Facial
services.description: Deep pore extraction, activated bamboo charcoal scrub, anti-pollution tan removal pack, and hydrating face massage.

services.name: Advanced Hydra-Glow Facial Therapy
services.description: Non-invasive vortex suction for deep blackhead cleansing, hyaluronic infusion, vitamin serum ultrasonic penetration and LED therapy.

services.name: O3+ Radiance Whitening & Anti-Tan
services.description: Award-winning skin brightening formula that targets stubborn pigmentation, uneven skin tone, and restores luminous glow.

services.name: Luxury Bridal HD Makeup & Hair Styling
services.description: Long-wearing camera-ready HD bridal makeup, luxury lash extension, traditional/modern hair styling, saree/dupatta draping, and jewelry setting.

services.name: Engagement / Party Glam Look
services.description: Dewy or matte high-definition glamour makeup with custom contouring, winged eyeliner, and artistic hairstyle.

services.name: Nail Buffing, High-Shine & Spa Care
services.description: Cuticle revival, organic almond oil massage, precision filing, and chemical-free glass shine buffing.

services.name: Gentle Kids & Toddler Haircut
services.description: Patient, gentle stylists praised by Wagholi parents. Fun and stress-free environment with hypoallergenic products.

reviews.author: Kavita Rathi
reviews.comment: Amazing highlights and balayage blend! The salon ambience in Wagholi is so luxurious and welcoming.

reviews.author: Rohit Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Had an incredible keratin treatment here! The staff really listened to how I wanted my hair managed without making it pin straight. Super polite team and the salon is spotless near McDonald's Wagholi.

reviews.author: Pooja Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Very friendly staff and clean setup. My haircut turned out even better than the reference picture I showed. They give genuine advice on hair maintenance without pushing unnecessary products.

reviews.author: Sachin & Sneha Sharma
reviews.comment: Bringing a 3-year old for a haircut is usually a nightmare, but the stylist at Maddy's was extraordinarily patient and calm. Truly grateful for their gentle handling. Highly recommend to all Wagholi parents!

reviews.author: Amitabh Roy
reviews.service: Royal Beard Sculpt & Hot Towel Shave
reviews.comment: Best beard trim and hot towel experience in the Bakori Phata area. Clean blades, fresh towels, and precision line-up. Very reasonable pricing for the quality they deliver.

reviews.author: Ananya Joshi
reviews.service: Luxury Bridal HD Makeup & Hair Styling
reviews.comment: Booked bridal hair styling and makeup for my brother's reception. The look lasted all night without creasing and photographed gorgeously. They are truly dedicated professionals.

reviews.author: Vikas Gaikwad
reviews.comment: Very relaxing facial and noticeable glow afterwards. The staff confirmed all steps before applying products. It can get busy on Sunday evenings so definitely pre-book your slot online!
